outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image with no averaged/aggregated plot; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B shows phase-contrast micrographs of cell colonies, not a plot of averaged data.

The bottom bar chart quantifying Annexin V/PI flow cytometry results (mean ± SEM, n=3) overlays individual data points (distinct markers per replicate) on each bar; the top representative flow cytometry plots are raw density/scatter data, not an average summary, so they don't require overlay points.
The bottom bar chart (mean ± SD, n=3) shows individual replicate data points plotted on the bars; the top panel is a representative flow cytometry plot, not an averaged summary.
Panel E is a heatmap of normalized (Z-score) gene expression; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Both bar charts (mean ± SEM, n=3) for pluripotency and lineage marker genes display individual data points (distinct markers such as circles, squares, triangles) overlaid on each bar.
Panel H consists of immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
